featured_reviews.review_text:
We have known Himanshu & Alka for over a decade and a bit as friends.  We first needed to professionally consult and engage them during Covid when we urgently needed a new apartment given space constraints in our living arrangements back then.

At that point in time,  Himanshu not only guided us through the whole rental property landscape but also provided a very scientific process of short listing based on our requirements.  We did not spend more than two weeks on finalizing our apartment and subsequently Himanshu drove the negotiations and discussions in-person and over email with urgency and comprehensiveness.  He also guided us with specifics of the Leave and License agreement as well as assisted us with registering the agreement,  closing out the payment terms across both sides as well as closing out all the necessary formalities with the admin department of our complex.  We were able to move-in to the new apartment within our deadlines rather seamlessly.

We needed to engage Himanshu and Alka rather urgently in Apr 22 again as our landlord was keen on selling the property at the end of our notice period.  They provided context to the changes in the rental landscape in our chosen complex and were very efficient in providing an extremely condensed shortlisting of rental properties given our requirements.  We were able to close in on our chosen rental property within a week.  They were very quick to setup an introductory call with the landlord and drive through some of our much needed furniture requirements despite initial reservations from the landlord.  As always, they guided us through the required agreements, closed out payment terms and coordinated with the admin department of our complex to make our moving extremely seamless.  All in all, were were able to move in within our deadline of two months which relieved our previous landlord and made both us and our current landlord happy.

The key service differentiators that they provide include the following:

1.  Accurate rental landscape research and analysis
2.  Comprehensive requirements gathering
3.  Efficient and pre-shortlisted properties for limited viewing
4.  Proactive guidance at every step
5.  Patience and committed assistance al through

I also want to commend them on their patience with payments and their solution driven mindset which provided much relief to us over our engagements with them.  I would strongly urge anyone looking for a commercial agent to strongly consider them as they provide unmatched commitment and incredible service while ensuring efficiency and operate within time and budget constraints.

featured_reviews.name: Patrick Stars
featured_reviews.review_text:
I strongly advise not buying a flat in Monte South. The experience here has been nothing short of disappointing and frustrating. The environment is not what we expected from a so-called “luxury” residence. Instead of a peaceful and upscale living experience, we are facing constant issues that make daily life difficult.

The biggest issue is the kind of people living here—many lack basic manners, and the atmosphere feels unrefined. There’s a lot of unnecessary show-off, but no real sense of community or decency. Some residents engage in unacceptable behavior, like spitting from upper floors, which is absolutely disgusting. The construction noise is unbearable, and the entire project seems poorly managed.

The staff is extremely rude and unprofessional. It’s clear that cheap labor has been hired, and there is no training in basic courtesy or service. The maintenance is a complete scam—overpriced, yet the facilities are in terrible condition. The air conditioning doesn’t even work in the lifts, making it suffocating to go up to higher floors. Hygiene is another huge issue—garbage and mosquitoes are everywhere, and pan stains cover the parking areas.

One of the most frustrating and recurring problems is the water supply. Every week, there is some issue—pipes breaking, dirty water flowing, or no water at all. Imagine being in the middle of a shower, cooking, or hosting guests, and suddenly there’s no water for hours! Right now, in my house, there has been no water in the kitchen for two days, except for one washroom. Despite multiple complaints, nothing has been resolved. The plumber comes and does nothing, and management responds with a casual “K” after several emails. It’s unacceptable.

We moved here expecting a high-quality lifestyle with minimal distress, but instead, it has been the complete opposite. This place is exhausting and mentally draining. People seem indifferent to the problems around them, and there is no accountability. The entire experience has made me realize the value of my old home, where life was peaceful, the energy was positive, and basic necessities like clean water were never a problem.

At this point, I am seriously considering leaving because the situation here is beyond frustrating. I regret moving here and would not recommend it to anyone looking for a genuinely comfortable and luxurious living experience. Not a homely feeling here.
There was even a fire here.
Video below shows how many insects and mosquitos come everyday.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Patrick, Thank you for writing to us. We are really sorry to hear about your disappointing experience at Monte South. Especially given the issues you’ve described with maintenance, water supply, and the overall environment. Please know that we are committed to ensuring a higher standard of service and living conditions for all our residents. To help us resolve this issues as quickly as possible, kindly share your flat number and contact number with us at sales@marathonrealty.com. Our concern team will reach out to you promptly to address these issues.
